segments.title: St. Patrick's Day Cold Open & Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the station sign-on as 'Papito' in full Irish persona; Hype Train in refractory period; Case and Pepito debate Irish stereotypes, green attire, and historical myths while thanking subscribers.

segments.title: Joe Kent Resigns Over Iran War
segments.notes: Case and Chet cover National Counterterrorism Center director Joe Kent's resignation letter stating Iran posed no imminent threat; White House pushes back citing Trump's 'gut feeling'; discussion of Tulsi Gabbard's silence and intelligence assessments.

segments.title: Time-Traveling Trump Sketches & Texas Fracker Escort Story
segments.notes: Case reads 100-year-old Charles Delch sketches allegedly depicting Trump and Barron; transitions to a western Texas fracker's podcast-to-sex-work pipeline story; Chet reads the headline repeatedly at Case's request.

segments.title: Park Interviews: Cum Man, Security Guy, Irish Cat, Mountain Man Mike
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein fields a parade of park denizens including a self-proclaimed 'cum man,' a resigned national security official (Rob Elvie), a pool cleaner named John Smith, a park ranger fearing for his 'dong song,' an Irish cat, Mountain Man Mike, and a face-shifting regular.

segments.title: AI Rooney Malfunctions: Foot Fetish Ghost in the Machine
segments.notes: AI Rooney runs on extreme delay; chat votes 'No luck of the Irish' as cause; Rooney outputs repeated foot-fetish rants despite Case claiming he removed the 'foot thing' from the personality matrix; segment cut short after 15 opinions.

segments.title: Battle Rap: Does Crum Deserve to Live?
segments.notes: Debate prompt: 'Do the people want to see Crum die again?' Crum spirals over pending gorilla dick punch, claims super strength from pulling a door off hinges; Munch and Crum trade verses; Crum's abortion/pro-life confusion derails flow; rapping banned permanently by Case.

segments.title: Peter Gibbon Wall Emergence & Sign-Off
segments.notes: Peter Gibbon crawls out bringing 'wall energy'; claims he eats munitions (drones and missiles); Case ends extra Monday stream, wishes Ricky P. Cochia happy St. Patrick's Day; raid imminent.

episode_summary: St. Patrick's Day broadcast opens with Pepito's Irish-themed sign-on before Case and Chet cover National Counterterrorism Center director Joe Kent's resignation over the Iran war. Trip Bradstein's park segment descends into sexual chaos, AI Rooney suffers a prolonged foot-fetish glitch despite claimed fixes, and Munch & Crum's battle rap collapses under Crum's existential dread over the pending gorilla dick punch — prompting Case to ban rapping forever. Peter Gibbon emerges from the walls eating munitions to close the extra Monday stream.
